description: This file defines a configuration class for the Recraft image editing API within a larger project, including methods for URL construction, parameter mapping, request transformation, response parsing, and environment validation specific to Recraft's API.

classes.name: RecraftImageEditConfig
classes.description: A configuration class for interfacing with the Recraft AI image editing API, providing methods for URL generation, parameter translation, request formatting, environment validation, and response processing.

methods.name: List get_supported_openai_params( self, model: str )
methods.description: Returns a list of OpenAI-like parameters that are supported and can be mapped to the Recraft API.

methods.name: Dict map_openai_params( self, image_edit_optional_params: ImageEditOptionalRequestParams, model: str, drop_params: bool, )
methods.description: Filters and maps OpenAI image edit parameters into Recraft-compatible parameters.

methods.name: str get_complete_url( self, model: str, api_base: Optional[str], litellm_params: dict, )
methods.description: Constructs the full API URL based on model, optional base URL, and stored endpoint data.

methods.name: dict validate_environment( self, headers: dict, model: str, api_key: Optional[str] = None, )
methods.description: Validates and sets the authorization header for API requests, ensuring that API keys are available.

methods.name: Tuple[Dict,RequestFiles] transform_image_edit_request( self, model: str, prompt: str, image: FileTypes, image_edit_optional_request_params: Dict, litellm_params: GenericLiteLLMParams, headers: dict, )
methods.description: Prepares the request data and files for the Recraft image editing API, converting parameters and images into the required format.

methods.name: List[Tuple[str,Any]] _get_image_files_for_request( self, image: FileTypes, )
methods.description: Creates a list of image files suitable for multipart form upload, handling both file-like objects and raw data.

methods.name: ImageResponse transform_image_edit_response( self, model: str, raw_response: httpx.Response, logging_obj: LiteLLMLoggingObj, )
methods.description: Parses the API response, extracting the image URLs or base64 data into a standard format.
